ravengard-plus.config.title: Ravengard Plus
ravengard-plus.config.enabled.descriptio: Draw a colored border around items whose lore contains a Crown value.
ravengard-plus.config.border_style.descr: Choose how Crown colors appear around item icons.
ravengard-plus.config.crown_value_overla: Draw an item's Crown value in the upper-left corner. Disabled by default.
ravengard-plus.config.inventory_total.de: Show the total Crown value of your player inventory below the ability slots.
When your usable inventory is full, highlight its cheapest item and mute container items that are not worth replacing it with.
ravengard-plus.config.add_tier.descripti: Add another configurable maximum value and border color.
ravengard-plus.config.maximum_value.desc: The smallest matching maximum wins. Use -1 for no maximum.
ravengard-plus.config.armor_upgrade_indi: Mark the best equippable armor upgrade for each slot. Greyed item models are ignored.
ravengard-plus.config.accessory_upgrade_: Mark the strongest accessory upgrade for each matching slot.
ravengard-plus.config.ability_cooldown_e: Track crafting-grid abilities after the game confirms their use in chat.
ravengard-plus.config.ability_cooldown_s: Scale the timer text from 50% to 150%.
Play a sound when an ability cooldown finishes.
Choose any registered Minecraft sound event.
ravengard-plus.config.always_show_hitbox: Display entity hitboxes without enabling Minecraft's debug hitbox view.
ravengard-plus.config.hide_armor_stand_h: Remove armor stand hitboxes from the debug view.
